components.content:
Leah Mosier is a cellist and percussionist who loves using music to tell
                            meaningful stories. She performs across a wide range of styles, including
                            classical and contemporary music, and enjoys working in collaborative
                            settings.

With years of experience in both ensemble and solo performances, Leah
                            brings care, expression, and strong technical skill to every piece she
                            plays. Her approach to music balances precision with emotion, helping her
                            connect with audiences in an honest and engaging way.
Outside of performing, Leah enjoys composing, exploring outdoors, traveling, writing calligraphy, cooking, and spending time with friends and family.
For performances, collaborations or inquiries feel free to reach out.

Looking Forward into the Rearview Mirror
